rationale: The previous iteration showed some progress improvement but the robot still failed to complete the tracks, with persistent line loss events (2 per trial), moderate RMS error (~0.022 to 0.024), and notable steering oscillations. The increased base speed and proportional gain improved forward progress but control effort and oscillations remain. To address this, I increased kp from 1.0 to 1.1 to strengthen steering response, increased kd from 0.04 to 0.06 to better damp oscillations, and moderately increased ki from 0.1 to 0.12 to improve steady-state error correction without causing overshoot. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they were balanced and appropriate. The line loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it is effective for recovery. I expect these changes to enhance stability and tracking precision, reduce line loss events, and improve completion likelihood. The requested measurements will confirm improvements in completion, progress, line loss events, RMS error, and steering oscillation.
